At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking an experienced Senior Game Designer to join our Music team, contributing across various aspects of highly social and music-based gameplay and interactive experiences. In this role, you will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to shape and refine music systems, tune gameplay mechanics, craft engaging activities and social experiences, and ensure compelling and expressive player experiences.

• Partner closely with audio and engineering teams to develop intuitive tools and mechanics that empower players to create, remix, and engage with music-driven experiences

• Minimum 5+ years of experience shipping multiple titles as a game designer, with expertise in systems design and multiplayer gameplay, ideally including music gameplay, rhythm mechanics, social experiences, and player expression features

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role:

Biology is the area where scientific progress has perhaps the greatest potential to directly and unambiguously improve human life — and we believe powerful AI could meaningfully accelerate the rate of biological discovery, helping compress decades of progress into years. With Claude for Life Sciences, we're building tools that accelerate the work of scientists and drug developers across the full lifecycle, from early discovery through clinical translation and regulatory review.

As the Applied AI Engineering Manager for Life Sciences, you'll lead the team of engineers who turn that ambition into deployed reality inside the world's leading scientific organizations. Our Applied AI Engineers are the technical front line: they sit with customers, understand their scientific and regulatory workflows in depth, and build the prototypes, integrations, and agents that let Claude do meaningful work in the lab and the clinic. You'll grow and lead this team, own the technical success of our most strategic life sciences accounts, those ties to advancing our strategy and mission, and create the feedback loop that turns what we learn in the field into better products and models.

This is more than wiring up a chatbot. As our own research has shown, the hard part of putting agents to work in biology is the infrastructure beneath them: messy databases, idiosyncratic file formats, scattered APIs, and metadata conventions where a single wrong or missing record can change a scientific conclusion. Your team builds the deterministic tools, connectors, and evaluations that make biological data reliably accessible to agents — and holds the work to a research-grade bar, where an answer has to be correct, reproducible, and auditable, not just plausible.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll coach engineers and raise the bar on their work, stay close enough to the technology to review prototypes and contribute directly, and partner across go-to-market, product, and research. Because this work sits in a sensitive, dual-use domain, you'll also help set the standard for how we deploy responsibly — enabling legitimate science while taking safety seriously.

In this role, you will:

•

Build and lead the team: hire, coach, and develop a team of Applied AI Engineers dedicated to strategic life sciences partners, setting a high technical bar and helping each engineer grow.

•

Own technical success with partners: be accountable for the technical outcomes of our strategic pharma and biotech deployments, from first scoping conversation through production.

•

Stay hands-on: review and contribute to prototypes, MCP integrations, agentic workflows, and Claude Code for Bio solutions; help the team get unblocked on the hardest technical problems.

•

Build agent-ready scientific infrastructure: guide the team in creating the deterministic tools, connectors/harnesses, and evaluations that make messy biological data and workflows reliably accessible to Claude — in partnership with scientists and research institutions.

•

Translate the field into the roadmap: partner cross functionally to turn what you learn from deployments into improvements in Anthropic's life sciences products and models.

•

Set the standard for responsible deployment: work alongside our safety teams to enable beneficial scientific work while guarding against misuse in a dual-use domain.

•

Build for the frontier: use deep knowledge of frontier model intelligence coupled to your work in R&D and research to rapidly progress toward solutions to meaningful problems in life sciences.

You may be a good fit if you:

•

Have led or technically mentored software/ML engineers, ideally in a forward-deployed, solutions, or customer-facing engineering setting.

•

Have a background in pharma, biotech, computational biology, bioinformatics, or clinical/regulatory affairs.

•

Have a strong hands-on engineering background and are comfortable reading and writing production code, not just managing those who do.

•

Have delivered technical work directly with external customers or partners, and can communicate credibly with both technical experts and executives.

•

Have built on top of large language models or agents

•

Are energized by an unfamiliar technical domain and have a track record of going deep fast.

•

Hold a high bar for reliability and reproducibility, and understand why a plausible-looking answer that's subtly wrong can be worse than no answer in scientific work.

•

Have built tooling, data infrastructure, evals, or agent harnesses that turn messy real-world data into something usable and trustworthy — especially welcome if in a scientific or research setting.

•

Care deeply about the safe and beneficial deployment of AI, especially in sensitive domains.

Strong candidates may also have:

•

Experience deploying LLM or agent systems in regulated or enterprise environments.

•

Experience building MCP servers, developer tooling, or scientific computing pipelines.

•

Experience scaling a customer-facing technical team through a period of rapid growth.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Please submit a resume to be considered for this role...

Responsible for the safe and efficient operation of various industrial trucks (gasoline, liquefied gas, or electric) to move, stack, and retrieve materials. This role involves precise handling of lifting apparatuses to transport goods across the facility, ensuring production lines remain supplied and inventory is organized.

This role will operate a stand up piece of equipment.

## Your responsibilities will include

* Safely drive and maneuver various industrial trucks (gasoline, liquefied gas, or electric) equipped with specialized attachments (forks, clamps, or elevating platforms).

* Perform precise material handling, loading, and tiering of materials into high-density storage areas.

* Ensure production lines are constantly supplied with raw materials.

* Maintain accurate inventory documentation, including recording weights or quantities on production schedules and labels.

* Perform basic equipment upkeep, such as lubricating parts or managing battery/gas levels.

Based on medical criteria for Powered Industrial Truck (PIT) operators, the following physical and medical standards must be met:

* Vision: Visual acuity must be correctable to 20/40 in each eye with no double vision and no tropia. The operator must have a normal field of view and color vision. Monocular vision requires individual evaluation.

* Hearing: Hearing loss must be no more than 25 dB loss at 500, 1,000, and 2,000 Hz in the best ear without a hearing aid.

* Musculoskeletal: There must be no ergonomic impairment of the use or strength of the back, fingers, arms, or other bio-mechanical defects that may interfere with the ability to safely operate a PIT.

* Medical Fitness: The operator must be "fit for duty" and have no uncontrolled illness that has the potential to cause unexpected loss of consciousness, equilibrium, or compromise mental alertness and judgment, including issues related to alcohol and drug abuse.

* Lifting: The role requires continuous lifting of 1–5 lbs, frequent lifting of 5–35 lbs, or occasional lifting of 35–60 lbs.

Education: HS Diploma or GED

Certifications/Licenses required: PIT License

Stand up power vehicle equipment experience preferred.

* Up to 80+ hours of paid training

Interns then attend divisional training where they learn the core skills required to be successful on the job. The curriculum focuses on the Sales & Trading business and the various products, processes and systems required to be successful in the role. This includes actively managing non-financial risk issues from identification through to strategic remediation and implementation of robust control solutions. IED Risk Management Counterparty Risk: Work alongside key stakeholders across Sales, Trading and Credit to review client portfolios and determine leverage levels, performing risk analysis for global multi-asset class portfolios to assess market and liquidity risks, across Prime Brokerage and Clearing. The team also contribute to articulating Morgan Stanleys risk management approach and performing due diligence with clients, understanding strategy, leverage etc. The team also focuses on working with Technology teams to further enhance risk metrics and systems across Equity Prime Brokerage and Listed Derivative/ Clearing business. IED Electronic Trading Risk Management (ETRM): The team manages daily risks relating to trading and execution. The team has primary responsibility for the electronic trading plant and the controls that govern it. Typical tasks include limit management, best execution monitoring, trader controls and governance of trading algorithms. Through partnership with the Trading Desks, Operations, Technology and Compliance, the ETRM team ensures orderly execution of client and firm trading activity. IED Flow: Primarily focused on single name synthetic equity flow in European, Middle Eastern and African markets. The product and solutions we offer are tailored to suit our clients strategies and requirements. IED Structured Products: Morgan Stanley offers synthetic derivative products to both institutions and hedge funds, allowing them to access markets with ease and simplicity. We also create bespoke structured solutions to meet client demand. IED Derivatives Client Relationship Management: Working with Morgan Stanley Sales teams and their clients to enhance client experiences front to back. The team also focuses on coordinating all new business opportunities across Structured Notes, OTC Derivatives and Convertible bonds. IED Stock Loan (Securities Lending): The desk facilitates short selling in European and EMEA markets. Both sales and trading work together to offer the most liquidity and information as possible to clients. FID ALM Team: The Asset and Liability Management (ALM) desk performs bespoke quantitative analysis, helping Morgan Stanleys clients (e.g., insurance companies, pension funds, banks, corporations and sovereigns) to understand and manage their cross-asset/liability risk exposures: interest rates, inflation, equity, credit etc. The ALM team has developed a range of complex simulation models that capture economic, regulatory and capital risks through time. These models are used to understand the potential performance of financial assets, providing valuable insights to our clients. The desk focuses on understanding economic tail risk, regulatory capital risks and ESG exposure analysis. The ultimate goal is to improve client relationships in order to win a larger share of clients high margin transactions. As part of the team, youll gain direct experience working on Morgan Stanleys Fixed Income trading floor, collaborating with Global and European Sales Management on initiatives that shape the client franchise across the EMEA region. This placement is ideal for students who are curious, analytical, and eager to learn in a fast-moving environment. Youll contribute to strategic projects, work with both Sales and Trading and our relevant stakeholders within the bank, and develop skills that are highly relevant for a future career in finance. Salary is competitive with excellent benefits. Study in a financial discipline is not essential, although you should have a strong aptitude for numbers. Job Title:

Capacity Manager

Job Description

Capacity Manager bij Concentrix

Als Capacity Manager ben jij de strategische en tactische regisseur van onze personele capaciteit. Je bent de functionele spil in de WFM-keten: van de langetermijnforecast tot de overdracht naar planning en real-time sturing. Jij zorgt dat onze klantteams op ieder moment over precies de juiste bezetting en vaardigheden beschikken.

In deze rol opereer je als een taakvolwassen, zelfstandig adviseur en sparringpartner voor Operations, Klantteam Management en onze opdrachtgevers. Je levert niet alleen analyses en scenario’s op, maar neemt proactief stelling, daagt stakeholders inhoudelijk uit en stuurt het WFM-proces functioneel aan om afspraken te borgen.

Wat ga je doen?

Met een vooruitziende blik (van circa 2 weken tot 15 maanden vooruit) vertaal je klantverwachtingen, volumeprognoses en historische trends naar een sluitend capaciteitsplan. Je overziet de hele keten: poolbeheer, in- en uitstroom, verzuim, verlof en werkplekbehoefte.

Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert knelpunten vroegtijdig en regisseert de oplossing. Zie je overschotten, tekorten of schommelingen in verzuim ontstaan? Dan reken je direct 'what-if'-scenario’s door en presenteer je voldragen adviezen op tactisch en strategisch niveau.

Daarnaast geef je functionele sturing aan Schedulers en (Senior) Real Time Managers, zodat de uitgangspunten van het capaciteitsplan naadloos worden vertaald naar de dagelijkse operatie.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

• Regie op het capaciteitsplan: zelfstandig opstellen en beheren van het capaciteitsplan voor meerdere accounts/klantteams over de middellange en lange termijn.
• Functionele aansturing WFM-keten: locatieoverstijgend sturen op de aansluiting tussen capaciteitsplanning, roosterplanning (Scheduling) en dagelijkse bijsturing (Real Time Management).
• Proactief & zelfstandig adviseren: Het management, Operations en externe opdrachtgevers gevraagd en ongevraagd adviseren over dienstinrichting, blenden van skills/kanalen en efficiencyverhoging.
• Scenario- en 'what-if'-analyses: Doorrekenen van beleidswijzigingen, acties, afwijkend verkeer en seizoenspieken, inclusief impact op kosten, FTE en servicelevels.
• Grip op de pool: Bewaken en forecasten van verzuim, verloop, shrinkage en contracturen; tijdig concrete wervingsopdrachten uitzetten richting Recruitment.
• Balans bewaken: Zorgen voor een gezonde balans tussen klantdoelstellingen, operationele kosten en een evenwichtig verlof- en beschikbaarheidsbeleid voor de medewerkers.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent een stevige persoonlijkheid die zelfstandig opereert en van nature eigenaarschap toont. Cijfers en complexe datasets zijn voor jou gesneden koek, maar jouw echte kracht ligt in de vertaling naar de business. Je hebt een hoge mate van organisatiesensitiviteit: je weet belangen te verbinden, maar durft ook een kritische spiegel voor te houden en tegendruk te geven wanneer de operatie dreigt vast te lopen.

Wat breng je mee?

• Werk- en denkniveau: Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau.
• Ervaring: aantoonbare ervaring binnen capaciteitsmanagement, tactische workforce management of strategische personeelsplanning (bij voorkeur binnen klantcontact of een dynamische service-omgeving).
• Zelfstandigheid & advieskracht: ervaring met het zelfstandig adviseren en beïnvloeden van management en externe stakeholders op tactisch/strategisch niveau.
• Tooling & Data: specialistische kennis van dataverwerking en modellering in Excel en sterke presentatievaardigheden in PowerPoint. Ervaring met toonaangevende WFM-software (zoals Verint, Genesys, Teleopti of vergelijkbaar).
• Talen: Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels.

Hybride werken met échte verbinding:

We geloven in de flexibiliteit van thuiswerken, maar vinden persoonlijk contact en een sterke teamdynamiek minstens zo belangrijk. Daarom ontmoeten we elkaar minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor. Zo sparren we makkelijker, houden we de lijnen kort en bouwen we samen aan een hechte organisatie.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een sleutelpositie met veel autonomie, waarin jouw visie en besluiten direct merkbaar zijn in onze operatie en resultaten. Je krijgt volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap binnen een informele, resultaatgerichte en internationale organisatie.

• Een passend salaris van €3.850,- tot €5.000, bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en expertise.
• Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.
• Een modern hybride werkmodel (flexibel werken vanuit huis en op kantoor).
• Goede secundaire voorwaarden, waaronder 25 vakantiedagen, pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding.
• Ruime mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling, WFM-certificeringen en doorgroeikansen.

Waarom Concentrix?

Bij Concentrix geloven we in taakvolwassenheid: wij geven je het vertrouwen, de kaders en de vrijheid om jouw stempel te drukken op onze WFM-dienstverlening. Geen micro-management, maar een rol waarin jij als vakexpert aan het roer staat van een optimale balans tussen mensen, middelen en resultaat.

Klaar om de regie te pakken?

Solliciteer direct via de button of neem contact op met Patrick Buitendam (Senior Recruiter) via patrick.buitendam@concentrix.com of 06 13 79 08 69 voor meer informatie over de functie.
